narrative.overview: The site is a Jupyter notebook you run. Every section is a cell. Markdown cells render headings and prose. Code cells show real source from this repository with an In [n]: prompt and render their results beside Out[n]:. On a first visit the page executes as you read it. That is the one piece of theatre the system allows, and it exists to show that the page is doing work. The mood is a lab bench in daylight: paper-white ground, graphite ink, hairline rules, and nothing that glows. Evidence carries the page: roles, real stats, and public projects. The handwritten study notes live on their own pages (/notes), outside the numbered flow.
keyCharacteristics: A graphite neutral ramp is the only tonal system.
One signal yellow that always means "running / active".
Geist Sans for reading, Geist Mono only where a notebook itself uses mono.
Flat: depth comes from rules and overlap, never from shadows.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Execution Yellow means running or active. It never encodes data, never decorates, and never marks selection. Text selection uses a neutral ramp step instead.

rules.name: The Chip-or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only as a filled chip with ink text inside, which keeps state readable without relying on a 1.5:1 color edge.

rules.name: The Mono Is Machine Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only for things a notebook prints: prompts, code, stdout, counts, dates. It is never used for headings or for style.

rules.name: The Overlap Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to sit above something else, it gets a rule, a tone step, or a chip. It never gets a drop shadow.

dos: Do use Execution Yellow only as a chip with Ink text, only for running or active state.
Do keep every code cell's input a real // #region block read from the repository at build time.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tone steps.
Do keep entrance motion under 300ms with a strong ease-out, and never animate keyboard-initiated moves.
Do frame handwritten page images (on /notes only) in a 1px Hairline at 4px radius.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows, gradients, or a dark theme section.
Don't introduce a second accent color or use the yellow for data, selection, or decoration.
Don't set headings in mono or add small uppercase kicker labels above sections.
Don't use a thick left border as a callout. Error output uses a full 1px border on Code Paper.
Don't show the owner's photograph anywhere, including social preview images.
